candidate_id.description: Empty when the stored request cannot be read.

result_state.description: pending: the worker has not recorded a result. unreadable: the stored result does not decode or has another schema version.

artifact_digests.description: Content digests of the built artifacts. Their storage locations are not exposed.

generated.description: True when the experiment's source was generated rather than supplied.

reasons.description: URIs inside a reason are replaced with [uri redacted].

items.description: The kernel planner's candidate as recorded.

invocations.description: Null when the profiler did not record it.

mean_duration_us.description: Null when the profiler did not record it.

request_timeout_ms.description: Absolute end-to-end deadline from gateway arrival through admission, retries, and response streaming.

connection.description: silent means no sync for three maximum poll intervals.

hardware.description: Content-free accelerator inventory the agent last reported; unknown fields are named, never guessed.

servers.description: Local servers the agent last reported, with engine, version, models, and health.

credential_cache_synchronized.description: False when this control plane could not refresh its credential snapshot at once; the key works within a second.

key.description: Agent key, returned once. It can call only the agent API.

run_command.description: Command to start the agent with this key on the server's machine.

address.description: The server's address as the agent reaches it; the control plane never dials it.

AgentSyncRequest.description: One agent sync. May be gzip-encoded; at most 8 MiB decompressed. Unknown fields are ignored within one protocol version.

metrics.description: Per server: the newest filtered engine scrape and, when available, the oldest scrape of the same engine process in the trailing five minutes.

sent_at.description: Agent clock; used to correct request-shape times for clock skew.

traffic.description: Content-free request shapes from the agent's local gateway.

commands.description: Reserved for candidate runs; protocol v1 sends none.

input.description: Protocol-native request body; encrypted before persistence.

credential.description: Returned once, on the poll that consumes an approved sign-in.

device_code.description: Secret the CLI polls with. Returned once; only its hash is stored.

model.description: Stable InferCrane endpoint name; migrated v1 deployment aliases remain compatible endpoints.

credential.description: Write-only provider API key. The plaintext value is never returned.

name.description: Human-readable connection name. It is normalized to lowercase and may contain letters, numbers, dots, underscores, and hyphens.

mode.description: How the control plane reaches this provider, for example BYOC, SkyPilot, or control-plane.

state.description: ready only when this control plane can create a billable resource; other values carry a reason.

workspace_owned.description: Computed for the caller. True when the calling workspace may deploy and optimize on this ready provider with provider_account billing and no compute_connection_id, because it is the bootstrap operator or INFERCRANE_OPERATOR_COMPUTE_TENANTS grants it.

evidence_class.description: Tenant-imported cost evidence is measured. Provider-reported authority is assigned only by provider adapters.

compute_connection_id.description: Verified tenant-owned compute connection. Required for provider-account deployments unless the selected provider reports workspace_owned.

endpoint_name.description: Stable application endpoint alias. Defaults to the deployment name.

gpu_count.description: Accelerators allocated to each runtime replica.

model_secret_reference_id.description: Tenant-scoped server-side credential reference for private or gated model resolution.

provider_adapter.description: Exact provider profile for this immutable revision; omit only when the cloud/runtime default is unambiguous.

runtime_env.description: Reviewed engine environment switches for the runtime's pinned image on the GPU's platform, such as VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER (0 or 1) for vLLM 0.22.1 on AMD Instinct MI300X, MI325X, MI350X, and MI355X. Any other name or value is rejected, and adapters that cannot pass it refuse the deployment before provisioning. Never put credentials here.

endpoint_name.description: Stable application endpoint alias. Defaults to the deployment name.

discover.description: Ask the control plane to verify /v1/models and resolve the selected model before adoption.

provider_connection.description: Tenant-scoped server-side credential and endpoint reference used for authenticated discovery.

upstream_credential.description: Write-only bearer token for the server, used for discovery and health checks. Requires discover. Stored encrypted with the tenant credential key; refused with upstream_credential_unavailable when none is configured.

url.description: Required unless provider_connection supplies the private endpoint.

analysis.description: Required in v2, absent in v1.

deployment.description: The deployment whose active revision was profiled.

schema_version.description: v1 carries call stacks only; v2 adds the trace analysis and an optional timeline excerpt.

timeline_excerpt.description: v2 only: the busiest part of the capture for a timeline viewer.

unavailable_layers.description: Layers this capture could not record, for example sass and stall without PC sampling.

GPUProfileAnalysis.description: gpu-trace-analysis-v1: where GPU time goes in one capture. Shares are 0..1; null is unknown and the section's reason says why.

source.description: Vendor datasheet the peak comes from, or operator.

truncated.description: The trace held more events than one analysis reads.

evidence.description: The measured values the sentence rests on.

improved.description: Null when either side is unknown or the change is within two points or two percent.

GPUProfileRecording.description: One content-free GPU profile capture: sampled GPU time attributed to root-first stacks of interned frames.

analysis.description: Required in v2, absent in v1.

schema_version.description: v1 carries call stacks only; v2 adds the trace analysis and an optional timeline excerpt.

timeline_excerpt.description: v2 only: the busiest part of the capture for a timeline viewer.

unavailable_layers.description: Layers this capture could not record, for example sass and stall without PC sampling.

gpu_ns.description: GPU time attributed to exactly this stack.

active.description: The capture belongs to the deployment's serving revision.

evidence.description: The measured values the sentence rests on.

gpu_seconds.description: Null when the bucket has no samples, never zero.

events.description: [lane, name, start_us, duration_us], start relative to the excerpt.

status.description: unsupported: the automatic check found the model cannot run on the pinned runtimes; missing_choices names the reason and the nearest reviewed models.

review.description: reviewed: a reviewed catalog entry. checked_automatically: not reviewed; its setup comes from the automatic check in model_check.

concurrency.description: Concurrent requests an unreviewed model's GPU is sized for. Defaults to 8.

context_tokens.description: Tokens per request an unreviewed model's GPU is sized for. Defaults to 8192.

model.description: Reviewed catalog name or Hugging Face repository. A repository outside the reviewed catalog is checked automatically when the operator enabled Hugging Face metadata access.

model_revision.description: Branch, tag, or commit of an unreviewed model; the plan pins the commit it read. Reviewed models always use their reviewed commit.

model_secret_reference_id.description: Saved Hugging Face token reference for gated or private models. The token never enters the plan.

policy.description: Amdahl materiality, target speedup, measured-evidence, and candidate-budget gates.

profile.description: Exact profiler identity and bounded operator hotspots; request-level monitoring alone is insufficient.

compute_connection_id.description: Verified tenant-owned compute connection used for this read-only probe.

sources.description: The committed runtime registry snapshots the check read.

checks.description: What was checked, one line each, for people.

considered_gpus.description: GPUs with a current price observation that the fit considered.

layouts.description: Every priced GPU type the model fits, with the fewest GPUs that hold it; fewest GPUs, then smallest GPU, first.

revision.description: The immutable commit the check read.

verdict.description: supported: the architecture is in a pinned runtime's registry, the model fits a priced GPU layout, and it can be read. unsupported: one of those is known to fail. unknown: something could not be read.

reviewed_model.description: Reviewed catalog name for this repository, when one exists. Prefer the reviewed setup.

error_code.description: network_error, http_<status>, destination_rejected, destination_disabled, or destination_unreadable.

event.description: Event name, or test for a test event.

response_status.description: HTTP status of the last attempt; null when no response arrived.

url_hint.description: Scheme, host, and the last characters of the path. The full URL is never returned.

name.description: Label shown in the dashboard. Defaults to the URL host.

url.description: Absolute HTTPS URL. A Slack destination must be an incoming webhook URL on https://hooks.slack.com/services/. Sealed at rest and never returned.

signing_secret.description: Webhook destinations only. Verify InferCrane-Signature with it. Shown once; delete and recreate the destination to rotate it.

events.description: Every event a destination can subscribe to, in display order.

name.description: Label shown in the dashboard. Defaults to the URL host.

url.description: Absolute HTTPS URL. A Slack destination must be an incoming webhook URL on https://hooks.slack.com/services/. Sealed at rest and never returned.

warnings.description: Warnings recorded on the immutable proposal, such as skipped experiments or unmeasured arms. Empty when the proposal recorded none; absent when the stored proposal cannot be read. Warnings are not performance evidence.

workload.description: The load the immutable proposal bound this campaign to. Absent when the stored proposal cannot be read or recorded no workload source. It states what the campaign replays, not what was measured.

fingerprint.description: For customer_observed, the bound Replay shape digest. For public_prior, the public prior's digest. Empty for reviewed_default.

profile.description: Workload profile recorded on the proposal.

source.description: customer_observed replays the customer's recorded content-free Replay; public_prior uses the public workload prior; reviewed_default uses a reviewed synthetic profile.

control.description: True for the campaign control, the current setup every other candidate is measured against.

label.description: What the setup changes, in plain words: the description written into the proposal when it has one, else the recognized serving flags (for example "Speculative decoding (n-gram)"), else "<engine> defaults". It describes configuration, never performance.

machine_replacements.description: Machines of this setup that were lost mid-run and replaced. A run replaces at most two per setup, and only while the approved cap covers it. A control plane released before this field omits it.

state_entered_at.description: First time the candidate entered each state, keyed by state. States the candidate never reached, or that a control plane released before this field never timed, are absent.

proposal.description: A complete infercrane.optimizer.proposal/v1 document whose normalized digest is revalidated by the server.

target_deployment.description: Required only for evolve_endpoint campaigns; names the stable deployment whose candidate revision will be compared.

accelerator_class.description: simulated_cpu numbers are never GPU results.

env.description: Reviewed engine environment switches the setup ran with; absent when none were set.

hourly_usd_per_replica.description: Sourced hourly price divided by the quoted maximum replica count; null without a sourced price.

accelerator_class.description: simulated_cpu numbers are never GPU results.

env.description: Reviewed engine environment switches the setup ran with; absent when none were set.

hourly_usd_per_replica.description: Sourced hourly price divided by the quoted maximum replica count; null without a sourced price.

banner.description: Fixed text every renderer must show: present only for simulated or CPU runs.

regressions.description: Headline outcomes (throughput, p95 time to first token, p95 latency) on which the setup measured worse than the baseline in its own window.

basis.description: Set on a regression: drifted_control_runs is read from runs whose control drifted and can show a setup is worse, never better.
Set on a regression: drifted_control_runs is read from runs whose control drifted and can show a setup is worse, never better.

change_percent.description: Winner relative to baseline, in percent.

noise_floor_percent.description: Noise floor from the interleaved control runs; null without them.

source.description: Who produced the winner's deciding evidence.

simulated_accelerator.description: True when any setup ran on a simulated accelerator or a CPU. Its numbers prove the pipeline, not GPU speed.

unknown.description: Paths of report fields whose input is missing or incomparable.

OptimizationCandidateMeasurement.description: Each AIPerf invocation of the candidate's measurement so far. A turn is one measured run of either arm: with a live control, C X C X C X C after one warmup per arm. turns_planned shrinks when the control drops out.

current.description: The invocation running now, or null.

error.description: Bounded reason when the invocation failed.
Bounded reason when the invocation failed.

OptimizationCandidateQuality.description: The candidate's answer-quality step, derived from persisted state. Answers and prompts are never returned.

command.description: The exact command that unblocks a waiting step.

eval_set.description: Digest of the customer eval set the campaign named.

role.description: reference when this revision's own answers are what the other candidates are compared with.

score.description: Built-in: mean answer agreement with the reference. Customer: the evaluator's score.

source.description: Who produced the deciding evidence: InferCrane's built-in check or the customer's signed evaluation.

OptimizationCandidateReason.description: Why the proposal included this setup. Present only when the proposal was ordered by an endpoint diagnosis. Priority and expected_benefit order measurement; they are never a measured or predicted gain.

role.description: control is the starting setup every other setup is measured against; diagnosis was chosen by a diagnosis rule. A diagnosis-ordered proposal holds no other setups.

OptimizationDiagnosisPlan.description: The endpoint diagnosis that ordered this campaign's setups. Absent when the proposal was not ordered by a diagnosis or cannot be read. It explains what was chosen and why, not how anything performed.

needed_evidence.description: What to collect before a diagnosis can choose a change, such as serving-engine metrics. Set when the campaign measures only the starting setup.

candidate_ids.description: Proposal candidate IDs that apply this technique; match them to campaign candidates by proposal_candidate_id.

skipped.description: Why no candidate applies this technique.

compute_connection_id.description: Verified tenant compute connection used to derive and immutably bind the executable provider adapter.

diagnosis_endpoint.description: Endpoint whose recorded diagnosis (readiness assessment over the last hour, engine metrics, and a GPU profile summary when one was captured in the last 7 days: kernel shares, plus the fired trace analysis findings with measured values and thresholds for a capture recorded with infercrane profile) chooses and orders the candidates. The proposal then holds the starting setup plus only setups a diagnosis rule chose; when no rule applies it holds the starting setup alone and diagnosis.needed_evidence says what to collect. The server reads the diagnosis; a client cannot supply one. The proposal records it in input.diagnosis and explains the order in diagnosis and each candidate's reason.

max_model_len.description: Context bound for untuned baselines of models outside the reviewed catalog. When Hugging Face metadata access is on and it is omitted, the server sets it to the length the model was checked for. Reviewed profiles keep their own arguments.

model_config_digest.description: Digest of the pinned model configuration that declared model_features.

model_features.description: Capabilities declared by the pinned model configuration. They gate experiments and are never performance evidence.

model_secret_reference_id.description: Saved Hugging Face token reference used to check a gated model outside the reviewed catalog. The token never enters the proposal.

quality_check.description: builtin runs InferCrane's answer check against the campaign control; customer_evidence waits for evidence the customer signs and attaches. Attached customer evidence wins in both modes.

quality_eval_set.description: Digest of an uploaded customer eval set that replaces the built-in prompts. Only with quality_check builtin.

search.description: Adds bounded, unmeasured runtime-recipe experiments ahead of the reviewed candidates.

OptimizationRunProgress.description: Where the run is, derived from candidate states rather than the aggregate campaign state, which reads ranked as soon as one candidate is ranked.

ended_at.description: When the last candidate reached its decision; null while running or when a decision time was never recorded.

eta.description: An estimate, built only from step durations this run already observed. Unknown until every remaining kind of step was timed once; never covers waiting for a person.

observed.description: How many provisioning, warmup, turn, and answer-check durations the estimate uses.

turns_total.description: Measured turns the run expects; null when a finished candidate's turns were never recorded.

OptimizationRunSpend.description: Spend so far, estimated from each candidate's sourced hourly quote, divided by its quoted maximum replica count, times how long its replicas existed. It is not an invoice. Unknown when a setup held servers without a recorded quote or its servers cannot be attributed yet.

QualityEvalSetUpload.description: At most 512 KiB. Unknown fields are rejected, so expected answers are not accepted.

delta.description: Candidate score minus reference score; negative is a drop.

follow_up.description: Operator action recorded for a WATCH verdict.

limit.description: Persisted threshold that decided a WATCH or BLOCK verdict.

regression_percent.description: Drop relative to the reference score.

model.description: Resolved immutable model identity, else the model the revision requested; empty when neither is recorded.

QualityVerdicts.description: Verdicts for the current candidate against the active revision under persisted Release Guard policy. Only state compared carries verdict, comparison_mode, reference, candidate, and evals. The stored Release Guard evaluation remains the decision of record.

verdict.description: Per-model verdict: the most severe eval verdict. UNKNOWN when evidence is missing or not comparable.

quality_watch_regression_percent.description: Per-eval drop above which a candidate is WATCH: promotable, with a recorded follow-up. Requires max_quality_regression_percent and must not exceed it.

metadata.description: Bounded content-free labels. Commands, files, prompts, outputs, credentials, and secrets are rejected.

payload.description: Canonical aggregate evidence JSON. Prompt and output content are not accepted by the v1 schema.
